files.content:
Ship confirmation placeholders

Production HTML is generated by ship-confirmation.ts inside the notify-pm Edge Function when notification_type is ship_confirm or quick_ship. Make receives the HTML in body / html / html_body.

  • SO# {{so}}
  • Customer {{customer}}
  • Carrier {{carrier}}
  • Shipped At {{shipped_at}}
  • Shipped By {{shipped_by}}
  • Container(s) {{containers}}
  • Weight {{weight}}
  • Comments {{comments}}
  • Logo URL {{logo_url}}
  • CTA / tracking URL {{cta_url}}
  • Email contact {{email_contact}}
  • Website {{website_url}}
  • Year {{year}}
